testo:
Kirifudash
Speed Attacker Mach Fighter Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, put the top 3 cards of your deck into your mana zone tapped, then put 3 cards of your mana zone on the bottom of your deck in any order.
 Kirifuda Revolution: During the turn you put this creature into the battle zone with the "Kirifudash" ability, whenever your opponent would put a creature into the battle zone, your opponent puts it into its owner's mana zone instead.
testo_jp:
Kirifudash
Speed Attacker Mach Fighter Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、自分の山札の上から3枚をマナゾーンにタップして置き、その後、自分のマナゾーンから3枚を好きな順序で山札の下に置く。
 このクリーチャーが「キリフダッシュ」能力によってバトルゾーンに出たターンの間、相手がクリーチャーをバトルゾーンに出す時、相手はかわりにそれをマナゾーンに置く。
